caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate goblet or chalice positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The goblet features a bowl with a scallop-shell design, consisting of repeated rounded, raised segments outlined with small bead-like details. The coloration of the goblet is predominantly shades of pink and purple with subtle marbled variations, giving it an iridescent and textured appearance. The stem and base of the goblet are formed by three sculpted, stylized legs that resemble animal paws or claws, each leg extending from the base upward and connecting to the bowl, with the legs also displaying a bumpy, organic texture in similar pinkish-purple tones. The base is triangular with rounded corners, and the same marbled coloration continues throughout. Near the lower right side of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "John Hall." The majority of the background is empty, emphasizing the detailed rendering of the goblet.
title: Marbleized Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
